member.name: T:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModule
member.summary: Entry point of a module. The host creates one instance per enabled module, on the UI thread, through a public parameterless constructor named in the package's module.json.
member.remarks: Lifecycle: constructor → → (zero or more times) → when the module is disabled, uninstalled or the host exits. Keep the constructor and cheap: heavy work belongs on a background thread.

member.name: M:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModule.Initialize(SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleContext)
member.summary: Called once before anything else. Store the context; do not block.

member.name: M:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModule.CreateView
member.summary: Builds the module's page. Called the first time the user opens the module; the host keeps the returned element alive (state is preserved while navigating) until the module is disposed.

member.name: T:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IBackgroundModule
member.summary: Optional: modules that must run without their page open (hooks, tray work, listeners). Requires "activation": "startup" in module.json; the host then initializes the module at startup and calls right after .

member.name: M:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IBackgroundModule.Start
member.summary: Starts background work. Must return quickly.

member.name: M:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IBackgroundModule.Stop
member.summary: Stops background work. Called before .

member.name: T:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleSettings
member.summary: Optional: the module offers customization. Requires "settings": true in module.json (so the host can show the tab without loading the module). The view appears in the "Settings" tab of the module's details dialog; changes should apply immediately.

member.name: M:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleSettings.CreateSettingsView
member.summary: Called the first time the tab opens; the host keeps the element until the module is disposed.

member.name: T:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleTrayMenu
member.summary: Optional: commands for the module's own notification-area icon, which the user turns on in the module's settings ("Show icon in the notification area"). The host owns the icon: its menu starts with "Open", followed by these items. Do not add an Exit/Close item: the module's enable switch controls its lifetime.

member.name: M:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleTrayMenu.CreateTrayMenuItems
member.summary: Called on the UI thread every time the menu opens, so items can reflect the current state. Return new MenuItem/Separator instances each time (an element can have only one parent).

member.name: T:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleViewLifecycle
member.summary: Optional: notified when the module's page is shown or hidden (pause timers while hidden).

member.name: T:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleContext
member.summary: Services the host gives each module.

member.name: P:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleContext.ModuleId
member.summary: Stable module id from the catalog (e.g. smooth-mice).

member.name: P:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleContext.InstallDirectory
member.summary: Folder the package was extracted into. Read-only: it is replaced on update.

member.name: P:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleContext.DataDirectory
member.summary: Per-module writable folder that survives updates (settings, caches, logs).

member.name: P:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleContext.Dispatcher

member.name: M:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.IModuleContext.ShowModulePage
member.summary: Brings the host window forward and navigates to this module's page.

member.summary: Contract version implemented by this host. A package whose module.json declares a higher sdkVersion is refused at install time.

member.name: T:SwissTechKnife.Sdk.SegmentedPanel
member.summary:
Host for Segmented.Item radio buttons. Draws one shared indicator behind the checked item and slides it to the newly checked item instead of jumping. Resizes snap without animation.
<Border Style="{StaticResource Segmented.Container}"> <ui:SegmentedPanel> <RadioButton Style="{StaticResource Segmented.Item}" GroupName="View" Content="A" IsChecked="True" /> <RadioButton Style="{StaticResource Segmented.Item}" GroupName="View" Content="B" /> </ui:SegmentedPanel> </Border>
